response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and leadership in project development, but lacks explicit evidence of executive-level leadership, formal project management experience, and sufficient German proficiency (only 'Basic' vs required C1), which are critical for this role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across multiple languages and environments (DLang, Node.js, Linux)
Demonstrated mentorship and workshop leadership in testing, TDD, and web internals
concerns: German language proficiency listed as 'Basic' — falls far short of required C1
No clear evidence of formal IT architecture design or UML modeling experience
Lacks documented experience managing teams or leading client-facing technical strategy
